newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Malaysian tycoon Kuok withdraws firm from listing.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian tycoon Kuok withdraws firm from listing.

text.p: Malaysian tycoon Robert Kuok's privately-held Allgreen Properties Ltd said on Friday it has withdrawn its application for a listing on the Stock Exchange of Singapore Ltd.
A statement issued by Allgreen's banker DBS Bank said the company decided to withdraw its application "in view of market conditions".
The decision comes just a week after news first broke that the company was planning to go public.
A DBS spokesman had said then "in-principle approval is expected before the end of the year".

Allgreen's interest is mainly the development of residential properties in Singapore and it also owns a large soon-to-be completed commercial complex, the Singapore $578 million Great World City, located on the fringe of the Central Business District.
A property analyst said the about-turn by Allgreen was surprising as local stock market conditions had remained stable in the last two weeks.
